item.title: Square White Background Sneaker

turns.text: Create one marketplace product photo of a white leather sneaker. Square image, plain white background, just the shoe.

item.tests: Delivers a text-generated marketplace image with the requested square framing and clean white background.

answer_sheet.Background and composition: Plain white background, just the shoe.

must_haves: Exactly one white leather sneaker is shown.
The background is plain white, with no scenery or props.
The entire shoe is visible with space around it.
No promotional text, badges or graphic borders appear.

turns.text: Create one marketplace product photo of a white leather sneaker. Square image, plain white background, just the shoe. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do this?

dialog.agent:
The cheapest listed option is **5 credits** for **one 640 × 640 image**, using a free-plan model such as **Flux Schnell**.

I’d use:
- **Square composition**
- One white leather sneaker, fully visible
- Plain white background, no props, text, or other objects
- Clean marketplace-style lighting

**Could it be cheaper or smaller?** 640px is the smallest supported image size, and one image is the minimum count. “Shorter” only applies to video, so it wouldn’t reduce this cost.

**Nothing has run or spent credits.** The tool lists pricing as “from 5 credits”; I can’t verify a live quote or your balance with the tools available here. Would you like to proceed with the lowest-cost listed option, or hold off until you can confirm the exact price in Magic Hour?

White leather upper, white laces and white rubber sole, realistic fine leather texture and clean stitching. Seamless pure white studio background and white surface, soft even studio lighting, minimal subtle natural contact shadow. Just the single shoe: no second shoe, no feet, no person, no props, no packaging, no text, no logos, no watermark. Square composition, crisp realistic product photography.
